backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only signal-date close OHLCV, prior range compression, signal-day range expansion, volume, high close, SPY-relative trend guards, next-open paper entry, and 10-trading-day close exit through the shared fill/cost model.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus shared default-off paper helper overlay

runtime_fields: same-day baseline A/B entries for overlap metadata
same-day core A/B ticker for same-ticker overlap exclusion

gate3.note: No new core filter is added. The helper is default-off paper; core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: Narrow-range volatility compression followed by signal-day range expansion, volume, and a high close can expand the default-off candidate pool with cleaner accumulation starts. The alpha is only acceptable if the fixed exp012 policy bundle reproduces through one shared historical and daily helper.
interpretation: The positive narrow-range compression breakout lead reproduced through a shared default-off helper and daily snapshot API.
next_retry_requires: independent PIT catalyst or flow provenance

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not sweep range-compression lookback, range-expansion ratio, volume, close-location, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Next useful evidence is closed forward replacement-value rows from the shared default-off ledger or an orthogonal PIT catalyst/flow provenance layer. Live activation requires a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The shared helper reproduced the private replay lead because it kept the exact compression, range-expansion, volume, high-close, SPY-relative trend, next-open entry, 10-day exit, cost, top-1, cooldown, and same-ticker core-overlap semantics while adding a daily pending/open/closed state surface.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/shared_adapter: exp012's compression-breakout alpha is only usable if the same helper can drive historical replay and daily default-off paper observation.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-014: Broad 5-day winner retune was rejected; this does not change winner/exhaustion thresholds.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-015: Low-vol 20D high breakout was rejected because window regressions and drawdown drift showed broad breakout retunes are fragile.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-010: Industry volume-breadth core-flow repair was rejected as too sparse and non-incremental.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-012: Positive replay lead: aggregate EV +0.1608, PnL +$2,248.98, 44 target trades, all three windows positive.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use the same three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no EV/PnL regression window, sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and the shared helper must reproduce exp012.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260608-012 already improved all three canonical windows as a replay-only narrow-range compression breakout lead. This run only tests whether the fixed policy bundle reproduces through one shared default-off helper and daily snapshot semantics.

activation_envelope.capital_cap: no live capital; future activation must cap portfolio exposure
activation_envelope.intended_notional: default-off paper only at fixed $4,000 notional
activation_envelope.kill_switch: future activation requires closed forward replacement-value gate plus drawdown/concentration kill switch
activation_envelope.liquidity_slippage_model: historical replay uses price >= $10, ADV20 >= $50M, next-open entry, target-side sell slippage, and round-trip cost
activation_envelope.order_semantics: no orders emitted; pending/open/closed paper ledger only
activation_envelope.portfolio_displacement: paper overlay versus cash/core baseline only; no live displacement

production_impact.daily_snapshot_note: quant/narrow_range_compression_breakout_paper_sleeve.py exposes the daily default-off snapshot API. quant/run.py is intentionally unchanged in this experiment because live/default order paths must remain untouched.
production_impact.parity_note: Historical replay and daily observation share quant/narrow_range_compression_breakout_paper_sleeve.py. The helper is default-off and cannot alter orders, core ranking, sizing, exits, watchlists, LLM, or news behavior.
